use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

fn value(text: &str) -> Value {
    if text == "null" {
        return Value::Null;
    }
    let (coefficient, scale) = text.split_once('@').unwrap();
    Value::Number {
        coefficient: coefficient.into(),
        scale: scale.parse().unwrap(),
    }
}

#[test]
fn matches_java_decimal128_quotients_and_scales() {
    const NS: &str = "urn:rust-proof:division";
    for (index, line) in include_str!("division_vectors.tsv").lines().enumerate() {
        let fields: Vec<_> = line.split('\t').map(value).collect();
        let [a, b, quotient, adjusted, mixed] = fields.try_into().unwrap();
        let actual = evaluate(&BTreeMap::from([((NS, "a"), a), ((NS, "b"), b)])).unwrap();
        let expected = BTreeMap::from([
            ((NS, "quotient"), quotient),
            ((NS, "adjusted"), adjusted),
            ((NS, "mixed"), mixed),
        ]);
        assert_eq!(actual, expected, "Java fixture vector {}", index + 1);
    }
}
